subject: Classwork complication for the module
text: About the classwork packet, I know it looked scattered when I sent the first draft, mainly because the timeline moved around after the instructor added a new rubric yesterday. I had already mapped the activities to the old categories, and some of those still make sense, but the final reflection section now needs a shorter prompt and maybe a peer-check list. The last-minute complication is that the shared drive folder was locked for part of the morning, so I could not confirm whether the revised worksheet belongs in Unit 2 or Unit 3. I think Unit 2 is safer because the reading matches, yet the project manager note said Week 4 might shift to the case study, which would make Unit 3 better. If we keep the original quiz, the word count is too high for a 45-minute session, especially with the demo at the start. Maybe the warm-up could become optional instead. I can split the tasks into printable and screen-only parts if that helps, though I would need a decision soon so the layout does not look rushed. The client note from this afternoon also mentioned a possible caption update, so if the classwork includes the video, that could create another small version-control issue I would rather avoid before Friday. If the current draft is still acceptable for internal sign-off, I can pause edits and keep the rest of the afternoon for the formatting pass. Sorry again for the extra questions; I do not want to hold up the review meeting.
